title: Google warns fully automated AI attacks are arriving
what_changed: Google's report says actors are experimenting with AI attack frameworks, not that they have adopted them at scale. The one-day PaperCut exploits were produced with LLMs by security researchers and Huntress, not by attackers. Zero-day figures now given as 8 a month in 2025, 11 in 2026 and 22 in August 2026.
